enrichedAcs: The CMS displays a preview control for draft content that renders the draft as it will appear when published.
The preview reflects unsaved changes made to the draft without requiring the user to save the draft first.
The preview updates to reflect edits as the user continues modifying the draft content, without requiring a full page reload.
The preview renders the current saved state of the draft when no unsaved changes have been made.
When the draft content is empty or contains only whitespace, the preview displays an appropriate empty or placeholder state rather than an error.
The system does not allow a user without preview permission to access the draft preview; the preview control is hidden or disabled for that user.
When the draft is in a state that cannot be previewed, the system displays an informative message instead of rendering a broken or incomplete preview.
